## Checked

- [ ] `make check`, `make tidy` and `make build-linux` are clean
- [ ] Tests cover the change through the public interface
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased for a change a user can notice
- [ ] Guides and doc comments describe the changed behavior, and a hard-to-reverse or surprising decision has an ADR
- [ ] A test with captured device bytes names the device and its software version, and the capture has password hashes, keys, SNMP communities, serial numbers and addresses removed
